question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to every macOS Talk session, or only sessions activated by Voice Wake?
rationale: The motivating problem and recovery flow are Voice Wake-specific, while the proposed public field changes every Talk activation; existing contracts do not establish which permanent behavior users should receive.

options.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track activation provenance and preserve manually started Talk sessions until users stop them.

options.title: Apply to all Talk sessions
options.body: Keep the general opt-in setting and explicitly document that manually started Talk sessions also auto-deactivate.

recommendation.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
recommendation.body: Track activation provenance and preserve manually started Talk sessions until users stop them.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main lifecycle work directly owns Talk shutdown and Voice Wake resumption.
